title: Latency & KPI Sprint Docket — Sofia's Pocket Notes
content:
Context and purpose:
Quick, tactical 1:1 notes ahead of my sync with Marco (eng lead). Goal is to leave with 3 measurable things he owns and 2 follow-ups I own. Keep to throughput/latency economics across API, Console, Dedicated, Private pockets.

Top-level asks for this meeting:
- Align on top perf regressions: which customer flows are highest priority to fix this sprint (API generation p95, console preview latency, dedicated warmup time).
- Decide canary policy tweak for model variant fallback (how long to wait before fallback and metrics to trigger).
- Confirm telemetry gaps + immediate work to add traces for batch sizing decisions.
- Agree on owner/timebox for KV cache tuning experiments (A/A then A/B).

Agenda (30 min):
0–3m: quick check-in (one personal + one risk)
3–12m: triage perf hotspots (show p95 numbers)
12–18m: canary/fallback policy decision (proposal + alternatives)
18–24m: telemetry + observability gaps (short list of missing spans/labels)
24–28m: action owners and deadlines
28–30m: quick retro on last rollout and blockers

Notes / talking points to surface:
- API p95 generation increased from 420ms -> 690ms last week after the model swap. Hypothesis: kernel selection fallback hitting for long context tokens. Need logs that map request token-length distribution -> kernel choice.
- Console preview: noticeable tail when users open large chat histories; UX complaints linked to dedicated routing decisions. Can we prioritize a small fix that serves previews from a low-latency cached path?
- Dedicated warmup: cold-starts are spiking after autoscaler changes. Is autoscaler now draining pods too aggressively? Check the scale-down window config (was lowered to 60s).
- Private deployments: customers asking for stronger SLAs around p99. Need to scope whether product can advertise p99 vs p95 for on-prem, and what infra changes that implies.

Proposal: Canary fallback policy v2 (short summary)
- If a request sees >2 kernel errors OR latency > 2x expected p95 for 500ms window -> immediate fallback to quantized variant for that request class.
- Add a 5-minute cooldown per instance after fallback to avoid oscillation.
- Metric to observe: fraction of requests routed to fallback + subsequent token-cost delta + quality regression (via eval set).
Tradeoffs: faster recovery vs potential QoE drop. Need a small eval prompt set to monitor quality.

Telemetry gaps (practical shortlist):
- Missing span: kernel_selector.resolve -> we need token-length and selected-kernel as labels.
- Missing metric: per-route batch size histogram emitted from runtime.
- Missing alert: sustained increase in warmup time (>300% baseline for 10m).
Action: ask Marco to carve 2 engineers (1 runtime, 1 infra) for a 3-day spike to add these traces and a basic dashboard.

Experiment plan for KV cache tuning:
- A/A for 2 days to confirm baseline with current cache policy.
- A/B small changes to prefix cache TTLs (50ms, 200ms, 500ms) and observe p95 and cache hit ratio.
- Success criteria: reduce API p95 by 15% on long-history requests without increasing token cost >3%.
Owner: Marco to assign; ask for names and ETA in this meeting.

Follow-ups I own (Sofia):
- Compile a 1-pager for exec-synopsis of canary policy with 2 slides: risk matrix + rollback playbook. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Schedule a 45m cross-team sync (runtime + infra + DX) next Tuesday to review telemetry PR and dashboard. Invite list drafted: Ethan, Nina, Marco, Priya, Lina. Due: invite sent by 2026-03-12.

Requested immediate deliverables from Marco (ask to leave meeting with):
1) Names of 2 engineers + rough ETA for telemetry spike (by end of week).
2) Confirmation to run the KV cache A/A next Wednesday (yes/no + constraints).
3) Decision on canary cooldown time (5m default) or escalate to on-call for exceptions.

Potential risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Fallback triggers cause quality regression and churn support tickets. Mitigation: small eval prompt set + canary to 1% traffic first.
- Risk: adding spans/metrics increases cardinality. Mitigation: sample high-card labels and keep token-length buckets coarse.

Loose notes / fragments to remember to say if time:
- Link the recent customer thread about dedicated SLA demands (ticket INF-1120).
- Call out that Optimize team suggested quantization profile Q3 as lowest-hanging for cost savings.
- Quick ask: can we get a perf-run snapshot export as CSV after the meeting for the p95 graph I showed?

End-of-meeting checklist (I will vocalize):
- "Marco, can you say out loud the 3 things you will own this sprint?"
- Confirm calendar action items and who will update confluence pages.

Scratchpad todos (short):
- write canary 1-pager (Sofia) — due 2026-03-16
- send cross-team invite (Sofia) — due 2026-03-12
- telemetry spike staffing (Marco) — due 2026-03-13
- KV cache A/A confirm (Marco) — due 2026-03-11
- perf-run CSV export (Ethan) — any time today

Notes on tone and exit: keep it outcome-focused, avoid deep architecture rabbit hole in this 30m; surface blockers and get owners. If we need more design time, schedule a deep-dive next week.

Quick log: last 1:1 we agreed Marco would prioritize model routing regression; he shipped a mitigation that reduced error rate by 28% — call that out as win to set positive tone.

End.
